title: Review findings
description: The one output of a review session (skills#195, skills#225). The driver validates it at Stop; the composer renders it into the pass file.

head.description: the head commit sha that was reviewed

pass.description: the review pass the order names

model_tier.description: the model tier the order names

findings.description: the findings, worst first; empty when nothing was found

file.description: the path in the pull request

line.description: the line, at the head commit

rule.description: the sentence the finding violates, quoted verbatim

input.description: the input that shows the departure

finding_basis.description: `decided` when the rule settles the case, `judged` when the finding is the reviewer's reading
